lines: A 125-billion-parameter AI on your own gaming PC, writing 94 tokens a second.
This is Strata. It runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a normal PC.
This voxel garden came from one prompt, written live on an RTX 5070.
Inside is a team of 24,576 small experts. Each word needs only 10.
So Strata shares the work across your whole PC: graphics card, RAM and processor.
A small helper guesses the next words, and the big model checks them at once: the same answer, 1.6 to 1.8× sooner.
On an RTX 5070 it writes 94 tokens a second, faster than you can read.
A coding version fits 32 GB of RAM and reaches 91% of the full model's SWE-bench score.
Setup is one sentence to your coding assistant: it checks your PC and picks the model.
Be patient: while the model starts, your PC can freeze for 1 to 3 minutes.
Send this to someone with a gaming PC and a 12 GB card.
Strata. Free, open source, and running at home.
